title.value: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF PFAS IN CERTAIN PRODUCTS

pfas_definition.provenance: Section 1(a)(11) defines PFAS as 'any chemical that includes at least one of the following three structures: (1) R-(CF2)-CF(R’)R’’, where both the CF2 and CF moieties are saturated carbons; (2) R-CF2OCF2-R’, where R and R’ can either be F, O, or saturated carbons; and (3) CF3C(CF3)R’R’’, where R’ and R’’ can either be F or saturated carbons.'

type.provenance: Section 1(b)(1) and (1)(l) prohibit the manufacture, sale, offer for sale, or distribution of certain products containing intentionally added PFAS in Connecticut

date.provenance: Section 1(b) and (1) set effective dates for the ban

who.provenance: Section 1(b)(1) and (1)(l) specify that manufacturers and suppliers must comply

action.provenance: Section 1(b)(1) and (1)(l) list the actions restricted

value: outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions
products.provenance: Section 1(b)(1) and (1)(l) list the specific products banned

value: products regulated under section 22a-903a or 22a-255i of the general statutes
sale or resale of a used product
products made with not less than eighty-five per cent recycled content
products manufactured prior to the prohibition
replacement parts for products manufactured prior to the prohibition
exceptions.provenance: Section 1(g) lists the exceptions to the ban

currently_unavoidable.provenance: Section 1(h)(1) exempts unavoidable trace quantities of PFAS attributable to impurities

intentionally_added.provenance: Section 1(a)(11) defines intentionally added PFAS as 'PFAS deliberately added during the manufacture of a product where the continued presence of PFAS is desired in the final product or one of the product's components to perform a specific function.'
